scripts.//shared: @cdip/shared is consumed as BUILT js (dist/index.js), so a stale dist is silently wrong: missing type exports are erased at runtime, but missing VALUE exports (QUEUES, objectKeys) come back undefined — a queue named 'undefined' rather than an error. Every entrypoint below rebuilds it first.
scripts.dev:api: npm run shared && npm run dev --workspace @cdip/api
scripts.dev:web: npm run shared && npm run dev --workspace @cdip/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run shared && npm run typecheck --workspace @cdip/shared --workspace @cdip/api --workspace @cdip/web
scripts.test: npm run shared && npm run test --workspace @cdip/api
